pr_title: LE Audio: CAP initiator API update
pr_body:
Updates the CAP initiator API such that the functions are more similar to each other, as well as similar to the CAP Commander functions. 

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/64556
pr_comments: Hi, the Footprint CI failure has been fixed upstream, if you rebase it should pass.
Added additional documentation for the parameter structs

issue_context.title: LE Audio: CAP Initiator API more consistent
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The CAP initiator API is pretty inconsistent. Consider the API for the CAP Initiator procedures:

```c
int bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_start(const struct bt_cap_unicast_audio_start_param *param,
					 struct bt_bap_unicast_group *unicast_group);

int bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_update(const struct bt_cap_unicast_audio_update_param params[],
					  size_t count);
int bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_stop(struct bt_bap_unicast_group *unicast_group);
```

One takes a single param and a group, one takes an array of params, and the last just takes a group. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Since we can always reverse lookup the group from a stream, suggest to modify the API to 
```c
int bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_start(const struct bt_cap_unicast_audio_start_param *param);
int bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_update(const struct bt_cap_unicast_audio_update_param *param);
int bt_cap_initiator_unicast_audio_stop(const struct bt_cap_unicast_audio_stop_param *param);
```

Which makes them way more similar, and will also provide support for stopping a single stream. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
The callbacks for these procedures can/should similarly be made more similar. They should only consider providing the failing `stream` (and not just the failing `conn`) in the case of an error.
